issue.title: test_canonical_query_round_trip_property fails Hypothesis too_slow health check
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** 

During pool-launch-reservation verification on 2026-08-24, the full just test-scoped lane failed this node with Hypothesis FailedHealthCheck: Input generation is slow. The failure reproduced immediately in isolation with the printed seed: .                                                                        [100%]
============================= slowest 20 durations =============================
1.12s setup    tests/test_plan_filter_query_canonical.py::test_canonical_query_round_trip_property
1.04s call     tests/test_plan_filter_query_canonical.py::test_canonical_query_round_trip_property

(1 durations < 0.005s hidden.  Use -vv to show these durations.)
1 passed in 3.16s -> FailedHealthCheck after only 2 valid inputs. The local diff touches LLM model-alias reservation/redemption and validator syntax, not plan filter query canonicalization or its Hypothesis strategies.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The node failed in the full lane and reproduced immediately in isolation on the same tree with the exact Hypothesis seed 102085564666404071502811727305596672010; unlike the plan-approval failure, the isolated rerun did not pass.

fields.description:
## CI failure

- Node: tests/test_plan_filter_query_canonical.py::test_canonical_query_round_trip_property

During pool-launch-reservation verification on 2026-08-24, the full just test-scoped lane failed this node with Hypothesis FailedHealthCheck: Input generation is slow. Reproduction: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_plan_filter_query_canonical.py::test_canonical_query_round_trip_property --hypothesis-seed=102085564666404071502811727305596672010 -q. The isolated rerun on the same tree also failed with the same too_slow health check after only two valid inputs, so this is a deterministic test failure rather than a full-lane-only flake. The local diff touches LLM model-alias reservation/redemption and validator syntax, not plan filter query canonicalization or its Hypothesis strategies.
